takes.overview: 6-1, #1 in projected strength (148.1/week) and 99% playoff odds - you're the favorite, so hold producing starters and buy at the need. Matt's Monstrous Team (6-1, 93%) is the only real peer; PuttinOnTheFoil (5-2, 71%) and Torts Illustrated (78%) trail. Goaltending is #1 across the board, but forwards rank #3 rest of season (1492 vs the league-best 1615) and D #4 (649 vs 737), so the next add should be a healthy defenseman: Vince Dunn (+49 ROS), Pavel Mintyukov (+48) or Darnell Nurse (+47) for Victor Olofsson. Bowen Byram (+52) tops the list but is on IR and out Saturday per Scott Powers of The Athletic - check news before chasing him.
takes.matchup: Up 73.1-71.1 on Angie's Bear Balls with two days left, projected 126-121 (61%) on 26 starts to their 24 - make today's fix and start Jimmy Snuggerud (STL vs NJ) over Victor Olofsson. Next week vs Mike's Magnificent Team is 58% (150-144), but they have the starts edge 71-68, mostly on Monday (11 to your 8), and Thursday is Thanksgiving with no NHL games. Best streams: Ryan Hartman for Jack Quinn (+3.2, Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun) and Vince Dunn for Olofsson (+2.8, Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat) - Dunn doubles as the rest-of-season D upgrade, so he's the move.
takes.roster: IR is jammed: Connor Bedard (OUT) and Dylan Guenther hold both IR slots while Pavel Dorofeyev, placed on IR Saturday per Peter Baugh of The Athletic, sits on your bench. Guenther was upgraded to day-to-day per Cole Bagley of KSL Sports - once ESPN clears him, activate him and slide Dorofeyev to IR to free a bench spot. Bedard misses the Blackhawks' next four games while they weigh shoulder surgery (Scott Powers, The Athletic) - check news, don't assume a long absence. Olofsson is the cheapest skater drop (costs 48 ROS), then Frank Nazar (71); Quinn (77) only for a short stream.
